name: SWE-ContextBench
description: Large language models are increasingly used as coding agents for software engineering tasks. Current benchmarks mainly evaluate whether the agent can correctly solve the request or fix the bugs. They largely treat tasks as independent and do not assess whether agents can reuse previous experience across related problems. As a result, the efficiency gains from reusing the previous experience remains difficult to measure. We introduce SWE-ContextBench, a benchmark designed to explicitly evaluate context understanding and retrieval in coding agents.
